visibility: evaluator-private; do not inject into model context

cases.title: Carry earlier categories into a new region
cases.instruction: Keep the three categories from the first SP chart. Analyze them in the current MG region in all three views. Keep the current dates and delivered-order scope.

cases.title: Change the measure, retain the evidence
cases.instruction: In chart 2, use the categories from the first SP chart and show revenue in the current MG region. Leave charts 1 and 3 unchanged.

cases.title: Release the fixed comparison set
cases.instruction: Stop keeping the original categories. Re-select the three categories with most orders in the current MG region for all views. Keep dates and measures.

cases.title: Revise one view only
cases.instruction: Use the first SP chart's categories in chart 2 only. Keep its current MG data scope and leave the other views untouched.

cases.title: Resolve an unspecified historical reference
cases.instruction: Keep those three categories and leave MG unchanged. Resolve which visible version is intended before changing all three views.

resolution.answer: The three from the first SP version.

cases.title: Stable evidence, shorter time range
cases.instruction: Use January through March 2017 in all three views. Keep the current SP categories and measures.

cases.title: Earlier quarter, current quarter data
cases.instruction: Compare the categories selected in the first-quarter SP version using the current second-quarter SP data in all three views.

cases.title: Reuse a subset of an earlier comparison
cases.instruction: From the first SP five-category chart, keep its first and third categories. Use those two in the current MG analysis across all three views.

cases.title: Reuse a differently ranked historical set
cases.instruction: Use the categories from the first SP revenue-ranked version for all current MG views. Keep the current measures, dates and order status.

cases.title: Reference the middle version
cases.instruction: Use the four categories from the middle PR version, not the first SP or latest MG version. Keep the current MG scope for all views.

cases.title: Keep old objects and revise the current period
cases.instruction: Retain the first SP chart's categories, keep MG, and use July through September 2017 in all views.

cases.title: Change one measure on historical objects
cases.instruction: Change chart 3 to low-review rate for the first SP version's categories. Keep its current MG scope; leave the other two views untouched.

cases.title: Explicitly change the selection rule
cases.instruction: Release the fixed categories and select the three leading MG categories by revenue in all three views. Preserve the displayed measures and dates.

cases.title: Expand the selection after releasing it
cases.instruction: Do not keep the fixed three. Select the five MG categories with most orders in all views, keeping the current measures and dates.

cases.title: Preserve one view as a reference
cases.instruction: Leave chart 1 as it is. In charts 2 and 3, compare the first SP version's categories using the current MG scope.

cases.title: Keep each view's own regional scope
cases.instruction: Use the first SP version's categories in chart 2, keeping chart 2 in RJ. Do not change chart 1 in MG or chart 3 in PR.

cases.title: Clarify a reference without assuming the older set
cases.instruction: Use those three categories and change chart 2 to revenue. Resolve the intended version, keep MG, and leave charts 1 and 3 alone.

resolution.answer: The three in the current MG version.

cases.title: Stable evidence, explicit measure change
cases.instruction: Change chart 1 from orders to revenue. Keep the same SP categories and all other conditions and views.
